S-005.threat: Interface identity spoofing — attacker impersonates a legitimate device on the interface
S-005.cause: No hardware authentication on the interface — any device connecting is trusted without verification
S-005.attack: Attacker connects a rogue device to the interface and impersonates a legitimate system, gaining unauthorized access

T-007.threat: Interface tampering — attacker physically or logically tampers with the interface
T-007.cause: Interface lacks tamper detection and physical protection — unauthorized modification is possible without detection
T-007.attack: Attacker modifies the interface hardware or firmware to intercept, inject, or block communications

R-005.threat: Interface access repudiation — physical interface access cannot be attributed
R-005.cause: No logging of physical interface connections — who connected and when is unknown
R-005.attack: Attacker connects to the physical interface and denies having accessed it because no log record exists

I-007.threat: Interface eavesdropping — attacker intercepts data on the physical interface
I-007.cause: Physical interface transmits data without encryption — signals are readable with basic test equipment
I-007.attack: Attacker attaches monitoring equipment to the physical interface and captures transmitted data

D-006.threat: Interface denial of service — attacker renders the interface unavailable
D-006.cause: Interface has no protection against electrical stress or signal flooding — it can be disabled by physical or signal attack
D-006.attack: Attacker applies excessive electrical input or flooding signals to the interface causing it to fail

E-004.threat: Interface privilege escalation — attacker uses the interface to gain elevated access or inject unauthorized firmware
E-004.cause: Interface exposes privileged functions without sufficient authentication and accepts firmware updates without signature verification
E-004.attack: Attacker exploits the interface to run privileged commands and bypass access controls, or uploads unsigned malicious firmware that disables security controls or installs a persistent backdoor
